nodes.label: D
nodes.title:
Invitation of Jesus.
The outer correspondence is about the identity of Jesus. The second corresponence is about Jesus's speech related to faith. The third correspondece is about words of Peter. The central part is about invitation from Jesus. This structure may indicate that the disciple become to believe by invitation of Jesus
